english.title: Fly UK aeroplane for public transport in non-compliance with section 1 of Subpart C of Part-CAT
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aeroplane registered in the United Kingdom and flying for the purpose of public transport, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which did not comply with section 1 of Subpart C of Part-CAT and was not flying under and in accordance with a permission granted to the operator by the CAA under article 127(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 127(1) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
